meta.name: hyperframes-registry
meta.description: Install, discover, and wire registry blocks and components into HyperFrames compositions. Use when running hyperframes add or hyperframes catalog, installing one item or every block matching a tag, wiring an installed item into index.html, or working with hyperframes.json. Covers discovery, install locations, block sub-composition wiring, component snippet merging, and authoring a new block or component to contribute upstream (idea → scaffold → validate → PR).

copy.tagline: 安装、发现并接入 HyperFrames 组件

copy.tagline_en: Install, discover, and wire HyperFrames components
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build with HyperFrames and need component management or authoring

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能运行 hyperframes 命令安装和搜索可复用的块/组件，并指导把它们接入 index.html 或处理 hyperframes.json。
howto.when: 当用户运行 hyperframes add 或 hyperframes catalog 命令，或要求安装/发现/接入注册表项时触发。

say.text: 运行 hyperframes catalog 搜索逐行显示标题的块
say.note: Claude 会按相关度排序并列出结果。

say.text: 安装 data-chart 块并给我连接片段
say.note: 会下载文件并打印需要粘贴的代码。

say.text: 帮我把 grain-overlay 组件接入 index.html

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude runs hyperframes commands to install and search reusable blocks/components, and guides wiring them into index.html or working with hyperframes.json.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user runs hyperframes add or hyperframes catalog, or asks to install/discover/wire registry items.

say_en.text: Use hyperframes catalog to search for a block that reveals a headline line by line
say_en.note: Claude ranks and lists catalog matches.

say_en.text: Install the data-chart block and show me the wiring snippet
say_en.note: Downloads files and prints the HTML to paste.

say_en.text: Help me wire the grain-overlay component into index.html
say_en.note: Guides merging HTML, CSS, JS into your composition.
